title: Tenant Onboarding with Complete Required Fields
description: Verify onboarding fails if any required business, privacy preset, unit selection, or user role field is missing, and succeeds only when all are completed.

steps.description: Start onboarding process for a new tenant
Attempt to complete onboarding with missing required business information
Check onboarding is rejected and appropriate error messages are shown
Complete all required onboarding fields including business details, privacy presets, unit selections, and initial user roles
Verify onboarding completes successfully and tenant is activated

title: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation Enforcement
description: Ensure tenant data is strictly isolated; users of one tenant cannot access or retrieve data from other tenants.

steps.description: Login as User A from Tenant 1 and attempt to access Tenant 2’s inventory data
Verify access is denied with no data leakage
Login as User B from Tenant 2 and attempt to access Tenant 1’s credit exposure reports
Verify access is denied and no data is returned

title: Inventory Intake Via Barcode and Text Search
description: Validate inventory intake flow using both barcode scanning and product text search to add products with multiple units and input correct quantities.

steps.description: Navigate to inventory intake screen
Search for a product by text and select it
Input quantity using supported multi-unit measurement
Select a valid reason for intake
Confirm intake is successful and audit log entry is created with correct user, timestamp, previous and new quantities, reason, and device source
Repeat intake process using barcode scan to select product
Verify intake succeeds with audit logging as above

title: Inventory Adjustment with Increments, Decrements, and Absolute Setting
description: Test inventory adjustment workflow for increment, decrement, and setting absolute quantities with enforced permission and mandatory reason.

steps.description: Attempt to adjust inventory without required permission
Verify action is denied
Adjust inventory by incrementing quantity with valid reason and permission
Verify quantity is correctly updated and audit log captures all details
Adjust inventory by decrementing quantity similarly
Verify correctness and audit log entry
Set inventory item quantity to an absolute value
Confirm quantity update and audit log recorded
Try adjusting inventory without providing a reason
Assert adjustment is rejected with error

title: Batch CSV Inventory Upload with Error Handling and Audit Logging
description: Verify batch upload of multiple inventory rows via CSV handles valid and invalid entries properly, logs all transactions, and reports errors.

steps.description: Upload a CSV file with valid inventory intake rows
Confirm batch import completes successfully and audit logs created for each row
Upload a CSV file with some invalid rows (e.g., missing required fields, invalid quantities)
Verify errors reported clearly and only valid rows processed with proper audit logs

title: Credit Limit Refresh and Exposure Reporting via API
description: Validate Credit Management API endpoints for refreshing credit limits and retrieving exposure reports, ensuring accuracy and proper authorization.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/credit/refresh-limits to refresh credit limits for a tenant
Verify HTTP 200 response and updated credit limits
Send GET request to /api/credit/exposure-report for tenant's credit exposure
Confirm response includes accurate exposure data
Attempt API calls without required permissions or invalid authentication
Verify access is denied with appropriate error code

title: POS Operation Speed and Privacy Mode Enforcement
description: Test POS transaction workflows ensuring sub-second response times, offline mode handling, alias auto-fill, and enforcement of configured privacy presets.

steps.description: Perform POS sale using barcode scan and alias auto-fill with privacy preset set to alias-only mode
Validate response time is under 1 second and privacy constraints are respected (e.g., customer PII obscured)
Simulate offline POS transaction
Verify transaction persists locally and syncs correctly when online without duplicates or data loss

title: Role-Based Access Control for Sensitive Settings and Data
description: Ensure strict enforcement of role permissions to limit access to credit policies, inventory adjustments, audit logs, and privacy configurations.

steps.description: Attempt to access audit logs, credit management, or privacy settings with a user role lacking permissions
Confirm access is denied and no data is returned
Access above resources with authorized role
Verify full access and ability to modify configurations where permitted

title: Audit Log Accuracy, Completeness, and Tamper-Proofing
description: Verify all inventory transactions, credit changes, and sensitive actions are logged with user identity, timestamp, previous and new values, reason, and device source within 30 seconds, and logs cannot be altered.

steps.description: Perform inventory intake, adjustment, and credit refresh actions
Check audit logs for completeness and timing compliance
Attempt to edit or delete audit log entries as a regular user
Confirm modification is forbidden

title: Privacy Preset Enforcement Including Data Burn and Export Restrictions
description: Validate that system applies privacy presets correctly including open CRM, max secure alias-only modes, and that data burn actions and export restrictions operate as intended.

steps.description: Set privacy preset to open CRM and verify customer data is visible and exportable
Confirm full customer details accessible and export allowed
Change privacy preset to max secure alias-only mode
Verify customer personal data is replaced by aliases and exports are blocked
Execute a data burn action
Confirm irreversible deletion of PII and audit log entry of this action

title: Audit Log Retention and GDPR Compliance Including Right to be Forgotten
description: Test compliance with GDPR including retention policies, irreversible PII deletion, and honoring user data deletion requests.

steps.description: Perform data deletion request for a customer’s personal data
Verify PII is irreversibly deleted from all tenant data stores
Check audit logs for required retention periods
Confirm audit logs retain necessary info but exclude PII beyond retention term
